2610.10437.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
2610.10437.paper_summary: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.
2610.10437.paper_summary_zh: 流政策捕捉了豐富多樣的行動分佈，並且通過離線強化學習進行微調以超越示範已引起越來越多的關注。<lb/>然而，針對學習到的價值函數微調流政策並不是一件簡單的事情，因為該政策在多個流步驟中生成其行動。<lb/>伴隨匹配提供了一種原則性的方法來更新流模型本身，通過將最終行動的價值信息向回傳遞到每個流步驟，但這需要在每一步通過政策進行向量-雅可比乘積，這一成本隨著流步驟的數量和政策大小而增長。<lb/>我們觀察到預訓練流政策的批量平均速度雅可比集中在其對角線上。<lb/>受到這一發現的啟發，我們推導出一個閉合形式的標量伴隨，該伴隨通過流時間縮放最終行動的價值梯度，消除了每步的向量-雅可比乘積。<lb/>我們進一步發現，在標量伴隨下，控制評論者在政策生成的行動中的價值特別重要。<lb/>基於這些發現，我們提出了帶有標量伴隨匹配的Q學習（SQAM），該方法將標量伴隨與這些行動的價值懲罰相結合。<lb/>SQAM的增益集中在四個最困難的OGBench領域，其中其成功率超過每個領域中最強基線的18到35個百分點。<lb/>為了測試SQAM是否可以擴展到大型預訓練政策，我們還在一個真實的雙手機器人上微調了一個視覺-語言-行動政策。<lb/>SQAM在所有三個任務上均優於監督微調。
